ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Written for Vaglio development; not any payer's coverage policy and not clinical guidance.

Example Health Plan - Medical Policy 7.1: Arthroscopic knee surgery

Covered services: CPT 29880 and 29881 (knee arthroscopy with meniscectomy).

1. Indications

1.1 Arthroscopic meniscectomy is medically necessary when the member has mechanical symptoms of the knee, such as locking, catching or giving way.

1.2 The member must also have completed at least six weeks of physical therapy or other conservative treatment without adequate relief.

1.3 A meniscal tear must be confirmed by MRI (CPT 73721) performed within the last 12 months.

2. Exclusions

2.1 Arthroscopic meniscectomy is not medically necessary for knee osteoarthritis without mechanical symptoms (ICD-10-CM M17.11, M17.12).
